page.overview:
What is Al-Azid's Ghostly Palace?

Al-Azid's Ghostly Palace was a magical building connected to a cursed key to its front gate, which could summon the palace to wherever the wielder desired.

The palace typically resided on the Ethereal plane, but could be summoned by the wielder of its gate key to appear in any plane in the multiverse.

This huge palace was made from fine white marble and was decorated with slender minarets, topped with gleaming golden ornaments.

The palace was invisible during the day, though occupants could see everything within the palace once they were inside. At night the palace shone with a white light. The palace was also protected against scrying.
